extension.description: Open extension point for custom properties

blocks.description: List pages should contain at least one table block
Form pages should contain form-section and form-buttons blocks
Detail pages typically contain tabs with sub-tables
Dashboard pages should contain chart and stat-card blocks

pagination.description: Whether the API supports pagination (default: true)

compactCols.description: Optional compact grid; existing grids are unchanged when omitted.

permissionCode.description: Existing block visibility and named-source permission gate.

businessOnly.description: Business-only history reads an existing named source and never requests audit activities.

scopePaths.description: Scope-only inputs, such as a requested range which is not echoed by the API.

knownValues.description: Unknown quality/state codes cannot silently become valid measurements.

AuthoritativeSourceConfig.description: Opt-in view over one existing named DMS source. No second transport.

optional.description: Explicitly allow an omitted/null field; it remains visibly unavailable.

SourceStateIndicator.description: An explicit business-state codebook, never a raw-code display fallback.

CardImageViewport.description: Visible artwork bounds in the original image's pixel coordinate system.

path.description: Read-only inspector path and presentation; values stay in the parent record.

placeholder.description: Business input guidance localized by the controlled renderer.

bindState.description: Mirror this field's value to a page state key (e.g. `statusFilter`) so data sources that read `${state.<bindState>}` (filter/search inputs feeding a list query) receive it. Without this the value only lives in form scope.

colSpan.description: Grid column span for this field (shorthand for layout.colSpan)

allowCreate.description: Reference fields only: show a "+ 新建" affordance to inline-create a target-model record and auto-select it. Default false.

createCommand.description: Override the create command code. Defaults to `${targetModel}:create`.

createPageKey.description: Override the DSL form pageKey used by inline quick-create. Defaults to `${targetModel}_new`.

createPermission.description: Override the permission code used to show inline-create. Defaults to createCommand.

createInitialValues.description: Initial values for inline-create. Exact `${form.<field>}` expressions resolve from the parent form.

createFields.description: Reserved (deferred): restrict the create form to a subset of fields. Not yet honored — full target-model form is rendered.

modelCode.description: Optional model scope for runtime reloads after same-model mutations.

adaptor.description: Defaults to optionList. Use raw to retain an API object's explicit paging or business metadata.

dataPath.description: Explicit path inside completed command data; no fallback.

rowProjection.description: Optional safe projection before commandArray rows seed a scoped form.

totalPath.description: Options require this total to equal the complete array length.

selectableField.description: Optional boolean path; false disables the corresponding option.

omitWhen.description: No omission fallback: optional fields must explicitly declare omitted states.

OmissionState.description: Declarative, bounded projection of read rows into explicit command payloads.

mandatory.description: Runtime personalization may reorder but never hide this baseline action.

preset.description: Designer-authored shorthand for common toolbar buttons.

action.deprecated: Use `label` for i18n display text. Kept for backward compatibility.

inline.description: Row actions only — render this button inline in the action column instead of collapsing it into the "⋮" overflow menu. At most 3 buttons are laid out inline (ux-design-system.md §3). When no button opts in, the first visible one is rendered inline, preserving the historical behaviour.

events.deprecated: Use `action: { type: "flow", handler }` for onClick handlers.

confirm.description: Confirmation prompt i18n key — shown before executing the action.

confirmVariant.description: Explicit confirmation style; omitted follows the button danger/variant intent.

permissionCodes.description: Every listed permission is required in addition to permissionCode.

reportCode.description: Custom report code (for report generation buttons)

includeRecordPayload.description: Defaults to true for legacy actions; false sends only configured and prompted fields.
Defaults to true for legacy actions; false sends only configured and prompted fields.

type.description: Execute the same command once per selected record with an exact target PID.
Collect one DSL field value, then execute the command once per exact target PID.

businessKeyField.description: Field name on the source record that provides the businessKey

variables.description:
Variable name → expression mapping. Expression grammar:
- "$.field" / "$.parent.child" — JSONPath-style record lookup (dot paths only)
- Any non-"$"-prefixed value — treated as literal Bracket syntax ("$.list[0]") is rejected by the platform dispatcher.

group.description: Optional business section rendered by the shared command dialog.

uploadedFiles.description: Configuration for type: uploaded-files; its submitted value is public file PID[].

dictCode.description: Static dictionary used to populate select/segmented choice fields.

accept.description: File chooser/type hint; server byte validation remains authoritative.

waitForResult.description: Keep this command input draft until the native executor reports its result.

width.description: Maximum pixel width, clamped to the viewport by the shared dialog.

closeOnBackdrop.description: Omission preserves backdrop cancellation for existing prompts.

successMessage.description: Success message to display after step execution

bulkCapabilities.description: Permission-aware controls for the generic edit/delete/export bulk bar.

bulkActions.description: DSL-configured business bulk actions, executed through commands.

rowActions.description: Row-level action buttons (displayed in each row)

treeConfig.description: Tree configuration — enables hierarchical expandable rows

showSummaryRow.description: Show the column summary/footer row (T10). Defaults to showing the footer automatically when any column declares an `aggregate`; set explicitly to `false` to suppress it, or `true` to force it. The footer aggregates the current page's rows only (see ColumnConfig.aggregate).

mode.description: Explicit opt-in for paged API data sources on a table block.

pageField.description: Use the declared response field; request parameters remain pageNum/pageSize.

presentation.description: Renders exclusive multiple-selection rows as one decision card per group. The bound value remains an array containing at most one row per group.

exclusiveBy.description: Field whose value defines an exclusive selection group. In multiple mode, selecting another row with the same value replaces the previous row.

optionLabelField.description: Field rendered as the radio option label in grouped-radio presentation.

recommendedField.description: Explicit boolean field marking a business recommendation. Automatic grouped selection is enabled only when `safeField` is configured as well.

safeField.description: Explicit boolean field proving that the recommendation is safe and reversible. A row is preselected only when both configured fields are strictly `true`.

emptyText.description: Localized placeholder for explicitly empty values, including empty arrays.

mandatory.description: Runtime personalization may reorder but never hide this baseline field.

precision.description: Maximum displayed fractional digits for numeric cells; defaults to 2 when omitted.

aggregate.description:
Column summary/footer aggregate (T10). When set, the list table renders a footer row showing this column's aggregate over the current page's rows:
- 'sum' / 'avg' / 'min' / 'max' operate on numeric/currency values
- 'count' counts non-null values (any type) NOTE: aggregates cover the CURRENT page only; cross-page totals would need a backend aggregation endpoint (out of scope). Setting this on any column implicitly enables the summary footer (see TableConfig.showSummaryRow).

editable.description: Enable inline editing for this column.

cellRenderer.description: Custom cell renderer registry key. Keep valueType reserved for built-in semantic types.

tagConfig.description: Tag rendering configuration (boolean tag: trueLabel/falseLabel + colors)

BusinessActivityDataSource.description: Optional legacy business activity query; named sources use the owning runtime DMS.

BusinessActivityDetailField.description: An actual nullable field of each business history row, displayed read-only when present.

blocks.description: Detail tab blocks (present only when tab is a DetailTabConfig in a union context)

permissionCode.description: Permission required to render this tab. Absent means the tab is not permission-gated.

filter.description: List tab filter (present only when tab is a ListTabConfig in a union context)

toolbarActions.description: Parent-record actions rendered above the child collection, including when it is empty.

actions.description: Row-scoped actions. Their command target is the selected child record.

rowActions.deprecated: Use actions. Kept for imported DSL compatibility.

defaultValues.description: Values merged into create payloads before editable row input. String values support the same `${recordPid}` / `${record.field}` templates as sub-table data sources.

treeConfig.description: Tree configuration — enables hierarchical display + drag reparent

allowInlineEdit.description: Enable inline editing of existing rows (default: true when commands.update exists).

editableColumns.description: If specified, only these column fields are editable inline

rowValidation.description: Enable row-level validation on inline edit (default: false)

crossRowRules.description: Cross-row validation rules (e.g., total amount <= budget).

intermediateParentField.description: Foreign key on intermediate model pointing to parent

filterCondition.description: Additional filter condition on intermediate model

value.description: Threshold value or field reference from parent record (e.g., "${record.budget}")

PageExtensionConfig.description: Serializable open extension boundary; retain the runtime's legacy any compatibility.

mobileHeaderHeight.description: Optional height at the declared mobile sidebar breakpoint.

WorkspaceShellConfig.description: Optional shared workspace shell. Omission preserves the existing shell.
